name: library-tab
description: Firefox new-tab personal library: manage tabs, bookmarks and history in a files-and-folders view.

scripts.sign: npm run build && web-ext sign --source-dir dist --channel unlisted
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --overwrite-dest && rm -f web-ext-artifacts/source.zip && zip -r web-ext-artifacts/source.zip package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts app.html README.md public src scripts -x '*.DS_Store'
